caption: The drawing shows a single object centered on a plain, off-white background. The object illustrated is a mezzaluna, a type of kitchen chopper with a curved blade and two handles. The blade is semi-circular, metallic, and rendered in shades of brown and gray, giving it a rusted and worn appearance. Attached at each end of the blade is a thick, short wooden handle, drawn in brown with visible wood grain texture and shading to depict its cylindrical shape. The handles are joined together by an arched, thick grip at the top, also depicted in a natural brown wood tone. At the lower left corner of the drawing, the name "CHAS. D. CHARON" appears in small, uppercase black letters. The composition is simple and minimal, with no additional objects or background details.
title: Chopping Knife
